exploit: resolveForDownload only consults cache.get on a hit and never asks store.getShare again, so once a share is revoked in the canonical store the cache keeps answering with the old file path until CACHE_TTL_MS elapses -- the two records disagree and the route trusts the wrong one
mitigation: make revokeShare call cache.evict(token) as part of revocation, or make the download path always confirm revokedAt against the canonical store even on a cache hit
